item.description: <p>As books about Chicago’s restaurant community go, “The Chicago Way: An Oral History of Chicago Dining” by Michael Gebert is a heavyweight — literally.</p><p>Close to five years in the making, the book (which is being published Feb. 2 by Evanston’s Agate Publishing) weighs almost 2 pounds.
